dialogue.origin: こんにちは。届いておりますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Hello. Is this message getting through?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello, this is the counselor.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございましたよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: では始めさせていただきます
dialogue.content: Then, let’s begin.

dialogue.origin: お願いします。
dialogue.content: Please do.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello, this is the counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 今日はお付き合いしている方の悩みなのですが、聞いて頂けたら嬉しいです。
dialogue.content: Today, I have a concern about the person I'm dating, and I'd be happy if you could listen.

dialogue.origin: はいそうなんですねどうぞ
dialogue.content: I see. Please, go ahead.

dialogue.origin: お付き合いはじめて2年たつのですが実はもう5ヶ月連絡が取れていません。
dialogue.content: We've been dating for two years, but the truth is, we haven't been in contact for five months.

dialogue.origin: えっ？
とても不安で‥。
dialogue.content: I’m very anxious...

dialogue.origin: はいそうですよねとても心配ですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's understandable. You must be very worried.

dialogue.origin: どのようなことがあったのですか？
dialogue.content: What happened?

dialogue.origin: それが、特に喧嘩をしたわけでもなく予兆があったわけでもなく
dialogue.content: Well, it's not like we had a fight or there were any warning signs.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 急に連絡が途絶えてしまったのです
dialogue.content: The contact just suddenly stopped.

dialogue.origin: えっ？・・・それはわからないことだらけですね
dialogue.content: Oh...? That must leave you with so many questions.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。私自身も気持ちに整理つかないし
dialogue.content: Exactly. I can't seem to sort out my own feelings.

dialogue.origin: 不安だし
dialogue.content: And I'm so anxious.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね何があったのか知りたいですよね
dialogue.content: Of course. You want to know what happened.

dialogue.origin: ご無事なのか・・・
dialogue.content: And whether they're even okay...

dialogue.origin: 気持ちの行き場がなくて‥落ち込んでいます
dialogue.content: I don't know what to do with these feelings... I'm feeling very down.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねそれは、苦しいですね
dialogue.content: I understand. That must be very painful.

dialogue.origin: 5か月前以前はどのようにお付き合いされていたのですか？
dialogue.content: Before these five months, what was your relationship like?

dialogue.origin: 週一回、忙しければ二週間に一回あっていました。旅行にもいったり遊んだりもしてたのですが‥
dialogue.content: We would meet once a week, or once every two weeks if we were busy. We also went on trips and had fun together, but...

dialogue.origin: はいそれは充実していたのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so it was a fulfilling relationship.

dialogue.origin: それなのに急に？・・・
dialogue.content: And despite that, it was so sudden...?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。最初は忙しいと思っていたのでこちらも連絡は控えていました。
dialogue.content: That's right. At first, I thought my partner was just busy, so I refrained from contacting them as well.

dialogue.origin: ですが2ヶ月も連絡をくれなくなったあたりから
dialogue.content: But after about two months without any contact from them,

dialogue.origin: 雲行きがあやしくなり‥
dialogue.content: I started to feel something was off...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 今に至ります。
dialogue.content: And here we are now.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね長い間、我慢されていたのですね
dialogue.content: I see. You've been enduring this for a long time.

dialogue.origin: 実は喧嘩をしたことがなくて。
dialogue.content: Actually, we've never had a fight.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねそれは、ありがたいことですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That's something to be grateful for.

dialogue.origin: でも余計ショックですよね
dialogue.content: But that makes it even more of a shock, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 5か月の間あなたはその方に何かされましたか」？
dialogue.content: During these five months, have you done anything to reach out to them?

dialogue.origin: すみませんお名前をなんとお呼びすればよろしいでしょうか？また、よければ年齢も教えていただきたいです。
dialogue.content: Excuse me, what should I call you? Also, if you're comfortable, could you please tell me your age?

dialogue.origin: はい。しつこくはしたくなかったので、月に一回のペースで連絡ほしいとかは送りました。
dialogue.content: Yes. I didn’t want to be pushy, so about once a month I sent a message saying I’d like to hear from them.

dialogue.origin: たまごでお願いします。20代です。
dialogue.content: Please call me Tamago. I'm in my 20s.

dialogue.origin: 送られたのですね・・・ありがとうございます。たまごさん
dialogue.content: So you did send those messages... Thank you for sharing, Tamago-san.

dialogue.origin: LINEみたいに既読になるのですか？
dialogue.content: Does it show a "read" receipt, like on LINE?

dialogue.origin: しばらく既読がつかずふっと1ヶ月後につくんです。が、それでも無視状態で。
dialogue.content: It won't show as "read" for a while, and then suddenly, after a month, it will. But even then, I'm still ignored.

dialogue.origin: それは・・・なんとも・・・
dialogue.content: That's... I'm not sure what to say...

dialogue.origin: 少し悔しい感じもしますよね
dialogue.content: It must feel a bit frustrating, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです！！こうされてる理由が知りたいのにって。
dialogue.content: Exactly!! I just want to know why they're doing this to me.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね理由を知りたいですよね
dialogue.content: Of course. You want to know the reason.

dialogue.origin: お付き合いするようになったきっかけはどのような感じだったのですか？
dialogue.content: How did you two start dating?

dialogue.origin: 最初は研修が一緒でした。そこで初めてお話してから少しずつ連絡を取るようになりました。
dialogue.content: We first met during a training program. We started talking there and then, little by little, began to contact each other more.

dialogue.origin: でも、
dialogue.content: But—

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: お付き合いまで15回以上は会ったと思います。お互いの気持ちが何となくわなりつつも、なかなか交際に発展するまでは時間かかりました。
dialogue.content: I think we met more than 15 times before we started dating. Even though we both kind of knew how the other felt, it took a while before our friendship developed into a relationship.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねお互い丁寧に向き合われていたのですよね
dialogue.content: I see. So you both approached the relationship very carefully and respectfully.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 研修が一緒ということでしたがどのような研修だったのですか？仕事？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you were in the same training—what kind of training was it? Was it work-related?

dialogue.origin: はい。仕事です！職場が一緒なのですが部署は違うので最寄駅は全然違うんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, for work! We work at the same company but in different departments, so our nearest train stations are completely different.

dialogue.origin: はいはいそういうことなのですね職場は離れているのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you work in different locations.

dialogue.origin: なので姿は見えないです。
dialogue.content: So I don't see them at work.

dialogue.origin: はい苦しいですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, that must be painful.

dialogue.origin: お相手はどのような方だったのですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of person was he?

dialogue.origin: 気分は安定してる人なので常時穏やかではありますがあまり自分のことをはっきり言いたがらないような所はありました。
dialogue.content: He's a very stable person, so he's always calm, but there was a side to him that didn't seem to want to talk clearly about himself.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね少し見えにくいところがあったのですね
dialogue.content: I see—so there were aspects of him that were hard to read.

dialogue.origin: それでも一緒にいるときは安定して幸せであれば十分ですよね
dialogue.content: Still, as long as you felt stable and happy when you were together, that's what matters, right?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。なのでお互いはっきり言うことに躊躇してしまう関係を築いてしまったかもしれません。
dialogue.content: That's right. We may have built a relationship where we both hesitated to say things clearly to each other.

dialogue.origin: あーそういうことを考えていらしたのですね
dialogue.content: Ah, so that's what you've been thinking.

dialogue.origin: お互いに気を使いあわれていたのですね
dialogue.content: You were both being very considerate of each other's feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい。自分にも恐らく火があると。
dialogue.content: Yes. I think I'm probably at fault, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですか？・・・
dialogue.content: Is that so...?

dialogue.origin: それはどのようにお考えなのですか？
dialogue.content: In what way do you think so?

dialogue.origin: しつこくしないようにと思ってあまり深く聞いたりする事をしませんでした。
dialogue.content: I was trying not to be too persistent, so I didn't ask too many deep questions.

dialogue.origin: 嫌かな‥って勝手に考えてしまったり
dialogue.content: I'd just assume he wouldn't like it...

dialogue.origin: 自分のこうしたい！を言わなかったり。
dialogue.content: And I wouldn't say what I really wanted.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね・・・相手を尊重しすぎて相手がいやだと思われることを避けられたのですね
dialogue.content: I see... You respected your partner so much that you avoided doing anything you thought he might dislike.

dialogue.origin: はい。でもそれが自己満足だったとしたら相手にも申し訳なくて。
dialogue.content: Yes. But if that was just for my own satisfaction, I feel bad for him.

dialogue.origin: そう考えてしまわれているのですね。切ないですね。
dialogue.content: So that's how you're seeing it. That's heartbreaking.

dialogue.origin: でも、そういうことも相手が気にしているとしたら一言欲しかったですよね
dialogue.content: But if your partner was concerned about those things, you would have wanted him to say something, right?

dialogue.origin: はい。何も言われないのが一番嫌だと感じました。存在を無視されてる気がして。
dialogue.content: Yes. I felt that being told nothing at all was the worst. It feels like my very existence is being ignored.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね自分の気持ちを理解して態度で示してほしいですよね
dialogue.content: That's right. You want them to understand your feelings and show it through their actions.

dialogue.origin: ちょうどコロナとタイミングも被ってしまったので
dialogue.content: The timing also overlapped with the COVID pandemic, so...

dialogue.origin: なんだか心に穴が空いてしまったようで。やる気も出なかったり。
dialogue.content: I feel like there's a hole in my heart, and I can't find the motivation to do anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・いろいろ良くないことが続いていますよねタイミングが悪いですよね辛いですよね
dialogue.content: I see... It's like a lot of bad things have been happening one after another. The timing is terrible. It must be so painful.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのところ一旦まとめさせていただいてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I summarized what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はい。お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: たまごさんは2年ほど前にお付き合いされている方がいらして5か月前から連絡が取れない
dialogue.content: Tamago-san, you have a partner you've been dating for about two years, and you haven't been able to contact him for the past five months.

dialogue.origin: 突然急に連絡が取れなくなり、月に1度つらい連絡ほしいと言っているが、1か月ほど放置されその後既読が付くだけで無視されてしまっている
dialogue.content: Contact stopped suddenly. Although you've sent a message about once a month asking to hear from him, your messages are left unread for about a month, and then, after showing as 'read,' they are still ignored.

dialogue.origin: お付き合いするまでもだいぶお会いする回数を重ねお付き合いしているときは安定された方だが自分のことを話したがらない印象があった
dialogue.content: You met many times before you started dating. While you were together, your partner seemed stable but gave you the impression that he didn't like to talk about himself.

dialogue.origin: たまごさんはしつこくしてはいけないと考え、聞かないようにされていた
dialogue.content: Tamago-san, because you felt you shouldn't be too persistent, you refrained from asking probing questions.

dialogue.origin: ご自身はわがままも言わないようにされ気を使っていたが気を使いすぎていたのではないかと後悔されている
dialogue.content: You tried not to be selfish and were very considerate, but now you regret that perhaps you were being too considerate.

dialogue.origin: このような感じでいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.origin: なにか、ずれているところ足りないところあれば遠慮なくおっしゃってください
dialogue.content: If anything is off or anything is missing, please don’t hesitate to tell me.

dialogue.origin: はい！おまとめくださった通りです！
dialogue.content: Yes! That's a perfect summary!

dialogue.origin: はいたまごさんがとても相手思いで配慮のできる方だと思いました
dialogue.content: Yes. I feel that you are a very thoughtful and considerate person, Tamago-san.

dialogue.origin: 5か月間も連絡も取れずに苦しいのに、それでも、まだ相手を思いやっていらっしゃる
dialogue.content: Even though you've been in pain for five months without any contact, you're still being considerate of your partner's feelings.

dialogue.origin: 本当に今がとても苦しいと思います
dialogue.content: I can only imagine how painful this must be for you right now.

dialogue.origin: 伺いたいことがあるのですが
dialogue.content: There’s something I’d like to ask.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご自身はとてもお付き合いされる方に、しつこくしてはいけないと思われていらっしゃいますが
dialogue.content: You feel very strongly that you shouldn't be persistent with the person you're dating,

dialogue.origin: それはどのようなきっかけでそのように思われるようになったのですか？
dialogue.content: What led you to start feeling that way?

dialogue.origin: 本当は5か月間も連絡をとってこられない、相手に否があるはずなのに、それでも、静かに待たれている
dialogue.content: The reality is that your partner, who hasn't contacted you for five months, should be the one at fault, and yet you are still waiting quietly.

dialogue.origin: 特にきっかけはありません。あまり相手を困らせてもいけないなぁと最初から考えたまでです。相手には相手の時間がある。って思ってしまいます。
dialogue.content: There wasn't any particular trigger. It's just that from the very beginning, I thought I shouldn't cause him too much trouble. I tend to think, "He has his own life and his own time."

dialogue.origin: お話していて気づいたのですが
dialogue.content: As we've been talking, I've realized something...

dialogue.origin: はい」
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: もしかして‥自分から線を引いていたのかもしれない‥
dialogue.content: Maybe... I might have been the one who was drawing a line between us.

dialogue.origin: って。今気づいてしまったかもしれません。
dialogue.content: I think I might have just realized that.

dialogue.origin: それが相手に伝わったのかなと。
dialogue.content: And maybe that's what he picked up on.

dialogue.origin: えっ・・・そうなのですか？それはどのようなことで思われたのですか？
dialogue.content: Oh... is that so? What was it that made you think that?

dialogue.origin: 相談員さんがしつこくしてはいけないって思ったきっかけを聞いてくれましたよね。でもきっかけなんて無いんです。
dialogue.content: You asked me what made me think I shouldn't be persistent, right? But there was no trigger.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: だから最初から自分が踏み込むことに躊躇してしまったのかなって。
dialogue.content: So I think maybe I was hesitant to get closer from the very beginning.

dialogue.origin: そういうことですえはじめからご自身がそうだったと・・・
dialogue.content: I see, so you're saying you've been that way from the very beginning...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 落ち込みます。笑
dialogue.content: That's depressing. (laughs)

dialogue.origin: それはとてもなにか苦しい感じがしますよね
dialogue.content: That must feel quite painful to realize.

dialogue.origin: いやいやそんなにご自身を責めないでください
dialogue.content: No, no, please don't be so hard on yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.origin: たまごさんは今までほかにお付き合いされた方がいらっしゃればどのような感じですごされていたのですか？
dialogue.content: Tamago-san, in your previous relationships, what were things generally like?

dialogue.origin: そうですね‥相手に自分出せるようになるまでには少し時間がかかるタイプなので
dialogue.content: Well... I'm the type of person who takes a little time before I can truly open up and be myself with a partner.

dialogue.origin: じっくり時間をかけてお互いを知るような関係を作る方が多かったかもしれません。
dialogue.content: So I've mostly been in relationships where we took our time getting to know each other.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね以前からそのような感じでいらしたのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you've always been that way.

dialogue.origin: 信頼関係を築いていくにはとても大切なことだと思います
dialogue.content: I think that's a very important part of building a trusting relationship.

dialogue.origin: お別れするときはどのような感じが多かったですか？
dialogue.content: When your relationships ended, what was it usually like?

dialogue.origin: お付き合いは2人しかしたことがないのですが、最初の方は自分から降りました。価値観が合わなくなってしまって。
dialogue.content: I've only ever dated two people. With the first one, I was the one who ended it because our values no longer aligned.

dialogue.origin: それはお金に対することだったので
dialogue.content: It was about money,

dialogue.origin: もう仕方がないと踏ん切りはついていました。
dialogue.content: So I was able to accept that it couldn't be helped and move on.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねそれは、重要なことですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That's a very important issue.

dialogue.origin: よく丁寧にお付き合いするからこそ、わかることがあると思います。覚悟もできると思います・
dialogue.content: I think it's precisely because you approach relationships so carefully that you are able to understand these things. It also allows you to find the resolve to make difficult decisions.

dialogue.origin: 相談員さんからの言葉をいただくと、自分を否定しすぎなくても良い気がしてきました。
dialogue.content: Hearing you say that, I'm starting to feel like I don't have to be so hard on myself.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねなにもたまごさんは悪いことされていないですよね
dialogue.content: That's right. You haven't done anything wrong, Tamago-san.

dialogue.origin: 自分を責める必要は全くないと思います
dialogue.content: There's absolutely no need to blame yourself.

dialogue.origin: ただ、一点、気になるのはご自身でも気にされていた聞かなすぎるところ・・・・
dialogue.content: However, there is one point that concerns me, which is something you also mentioned: the part about not asking enough...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相手にあなたの本心をわかってもらえなければこんなに苦しい思いになってしまうことが、残念でなりません
dialogue.content: It's truly unfortunate that when your partner doesn't understand your true feelings, it can lead to such painful emotions for you.

dialogue.origin: 少し話が変わってしまうのですが、ご家族のことを伺ってもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: This is a bit of a change of subject, but may I ask about your family?

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: たまごさんはどのようなご家庭でいらしているのですか？
dialogue.content: Tamago-san, what kind of family did you grow up in?

dialogue.origin: 父、母、３つ下の弟がいます！
dialogue.content: I have a father, a mother, and a brother who is three years younger than me.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねご長女でいらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you're the eldest daughter.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: 今もご一緒に？
dialogue.content: Are you still living with them?

dialogue.origin: 4人で暮らしているのですか？
dialogue.content: Are the four of you living together?

dialogue.origin: 自分も弟も実家を出て一人暮らしです。
dialogue.content: Both my brother and I have moved out and are living on our own.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねそれは、しっかり皆さんされていますね
dialogue.content: I see. You are all very independent.

dialogue.origin: ご両親に対してはどのようなお気持ちでいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about your parents?

dialogue.origin: そうですね‥凄い大切に育てて貰ったという感じです。学生の時は心が疲れてしまって病んだこともあったのでかなり迷惑をかけた気がします。でも包み込んでくれました。
dialogue.content: Well... I feel like they raised me with a great deal of love and care. When I was a student, I went through a period of being mentally exhausted and unwell, and I feel I caused them a lot of trouble. But they completely accepted me.

dialogue.origin: でもあまり自分の意見は言わなかったです
dialogue.content: But I didn't really express my own opinions much.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね包み込んでくださったのですねそれは心強かったですね
dialogue.content: I see—they embraced you completely. That must have been very reassuring.

dialogue.origin: ご長女としてしっかりしようと頑張られていたのですよね
dialogue.content: As the eldest daughter, you were trying your best to be responsible, weren't you?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですかね‥実感はないです。笑
dialogue.content: I wonder... I don't really feel that way myself. (laughs)

dialogue.origin: 意識しないですよね・・・でも、いつのまにかそう感じていたのかもしれません
dialogue.content: It's not something you're always conscious of... but perhaps you came to feel that way over time without realizing it.

dialogue.origin: 意見を言わないということですが、具体的に思い出されることはありますか？
dialogue.content: Regarding not expressing your opinions, do any specific examples come to mind?

dialogue.origin: 温かく包み込んでくださるならわがままも言えたのかなと思ってしまいました。
dialogue.content: I was just thinking that since they were so warm and accepting, you might have been able to express your own wants a little more.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。なぜか両親を喜ばせようと、意見を先に聞いてそちらを、優先するクセはありますね。今でもしてしまうかも‥！！
dialogue.content: That's true. For some reason, I have a habit of trying to please my parents by asking for their opinion first and prioritizing it. I think I might still do it now...!

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね本当に根っこからそういう優しい方なんですね
dialogue.content: I see. You really are a genuinely kind person, down to your core.

dialogue.origin: 相手を喜ばせたいのですよね
dialogue.content: You want to make others happy, don't you?

dialogue.origin: 自分で優しさ売ったみたいで恥ずかしいです、、
dialogue.content: I'm embarrassed, it feels like I'm bragging about my own kindness...

dialogue.origin: いえいえぜんぜんでもそう行動されているとご両親はどうでしたか？
dialogue.content: No, not at all. When you acted that way, how did your parents respond?

dialogue.origin: 喜んでくれます。それがまた自分の嬉しさにも繋がります。
dialogue.content: It makes them happy, and that, in turn, makes me happy too.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねだから、また、そうしようと思いますよね。すごく良い関係ができて居心地もよかったと思います。学生の時に大変なことがあったようですがその時はたまごさんはご家族に
dialogue.content: Right. And so that makes you want to do it again. It sounds like you built a very good, comfortable relationship. You mentioned you went through a difficult time as a student; during that time, did you...

dialogue.origin: どのように相談されたのですか？
dialogue.content: ...how did you talk to them about it?

dialogue.origin: ブツぎれですみません
dialogue.content: Sorry for the fragmented messages.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ！その時は体調面にあらわになって出てきたので、言わなくても気づかれてしまった所はあります。それからは、直接話をして相談は出来ていました。
dialogue.content: Not at all! At the time, my issues started to manifest physically, so they noticed even without me saying anything. From then on, I was able to talk with them directly.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね体調面に・・・それは大変でした
dialogue.content: I see, so it affected you physically... That must have been very difficult.

dialogue.origin: 見てわかるぐらいまで耐えてしまっていたのですね
dialogue.content: So you endured it to the point where it became physically visible to others.

dialogue.origin: 言われてみれば‥そうですね笑でも今は健康そのものって感じです！
dialogue.content: Now that you mention it... I guess that's true. (laughs) But I'm the picture of health now!

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね良かったです。ご家族の支えはとても大きかったと思います。
dialogue.content: That's wonderful to hear. I'm sure your family's support was a huge help.

dialogue.origin: 私から少し提案してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I offer a small suggestion?

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: 今回の件ですが私としては結果はどのようになってしまうかわからないですがご自身の思いを一度伝えるべきかと思いました。
dialogue.content: Regarding this situation, while I can't say what the outcome will be, I feel that you should try to convey your feelings to him at least once.

dialogue.origin: 今までのたまごさんの様子を想像しますと目に見えるまで、気づいてもらえない可能性があります
dialogue.content: Based on our conversation about your past experiences, Tamago-san, there's a possibility that he won't notice how you're feeling unless it becomes physically visible.

dialogue.origin: とはいえいまさら急に何をすればと悩んでしまうかと思います
dialogue.content: That being said, I imagine you're probably wondering what you could possibly do so suddenly at this point.

dialogue.origin: まずは、出さなくてもよいので手紙を書いてみてほしいです
dialogue.content: First, I would like you to try writing a letter. You don't have to send it.

dialogue.origin: しっかりご自身のことを吐き出して、お相手への思いもつづったものを、自分で書いてそれから読み直してみてください
dialogue.content: Pour out all of your own feelings and your feelings toward your partner, write it all down, and then please try reading it back to yourself.

dialogue.origin: 読み直してからご自身の次の行動を考えてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: After reading it over, perhaps you could then think about what your next step should be.

dialogue.origin: もしも、手紙を読んでもらう勇気が湧いてきたらチャレンジしてみてほしいです。
dialogue.content: And if you find the courage to let him read the letter, I hope you'll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: なるほど！自分の頭で考えていても進まないですよね。一度書いて整理してみるということですね！
dialogue.content: I see! Just thinking about it in my head won't get me anywhere. It's about writing everything down to sort out my thoughts, right?

dialogue.origin: 思いをぶつける。
dialogue.content: To get all my feelings out.

dialogue.origin: はいその通りです。渡す勇気がわかなかったとしても気持ちに整理がついてくると思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's exactly right. Even if you don't find the courage to give it to him, I think the exercise will help you sort out your own feelings.

dialogue.origin: わかりました！自分1人では思いつかなかったことでした。
dialogue.content: I understand! I wouldn't have thought of that on my own.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.content: Thank you!

dialogue.origin: ぜひやってみていただきたいですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I'd really like you to give it a try. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: はい。前進させるためにも早速やってみようと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes. In order to move forward, I'll try it right away.

dialogue.origin: 私はこの今日のお話を聞かせていただいて、このことがお相手の方に伝わることはすごく大切なことだと思いました。
dialogue.content: After listening to your story today, I feel that it's incredibly important for your partner to understand these things.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。伝えなければ伝わらないですよね。
dialogue.content: You're right. If I don't tell him, he'll never know.

dialogue.origin: もちろんそれが一番ですが・・・伝えられなくても自分のこともとよく気づいてあげてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Of course, that's the ideal outcome... but even if you can't tell him, please make sure to be aware of and acknowledge your own feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: それでは今日はこれでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Shall we wrap things up for today?

dialogue.origin: はい。自分の思いも聞いて頂けて少しスッキリしたのと自分が今やるべきことにも気付けたと思います。お手紙のご提案も下さったので、一歩進んでみようと思いました。
dialogue.content: Yes. I feel a bit better now that I've been able to talk about my feelings, and I think I've also realized what I need to do now. Your suggestion about the letter has made me feel like I can take a step forward.

dialogue.origin: 今日は聞いてくださってありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you so much for listening today!

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました応援しています！！
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. I'll be rooting for you!

dialogue.origin: それではロールプレイを終わりにいたしますありがとうございました
dialogue.content: We’ll end the role-play here. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you!

dialogue.origin: 失礼します。
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

topic.sub: 連絡が途絶えた彼とのコミュニケーション問題
